kbdStepsHead: How to add a block without a mouse:
kbdStep1: Press [[Tab]] to move into the program area, then press [[Ctrl]]+[[Shift]]+[[K]].
kbdStep2: [[D]] and [[S]]: move the cursor under the last block of the program (a line will appear there).
kbdStep4: [[T]]: go to the block panel, [[S]]: pick the block you need.
kbdStep5: [[Enter]]: the block will snap into the marked spot.
kbdAll1: [[Ctrl]]+[[Shift]]+[[K]]: turn keyboard mode on or off (the workspace must have focus).
kbdAll2: [[W]] [[A]] [[S]] [[D]]: move between blocks: up, out, down, in.
kbdAll3: [[T]]: go to the block panel; [[W]]/[[S]]: choose a category, [[D]]: open its blocks.
kbdAll4: [[Enter]]: in the block panel, take a block into the program; in the program, mark the place to insert.
kbdAll5: [[I]]: insert (attach) the block at the marked spot. [[Shift]]+[[W]]/[[A]]/[[S]]/[[D]]: move the cursor over empty workspace.
kbdAll6: [[X]]: detach a block. [[Delete]] or [[Backspace]]: delete the selected block.
kbdAll7: [[Esc]] or [[E]]: go back from the block panel to the program.
